name: Textural Complexity Objective
definition: Objective T corresponds to the photometric variation of images taken at camera-pose c_k. It is computed with respect to 2D projections of the object rather than the 3D mesh, as textural characteristics are discernible in 2D.
summary: The Textural Complexity Objective is a 2D metric that identifies camera poses with high photometric variation by analyzing Local Binary Patterns in Hue and Saturation channels, unlike geometric metrics that rely on 3D mesh structure.
